rows.title: Lost in Translation
rows.overview: Two lost souls visiting Tokyo -- the young, neglected wife of a photographer and a washed-up movie star shooting a TV commercial -- find an odd solace and pensive freedom to be real in each other's company, away from their lives in America.

rows.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
rows.overview: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.

rows.title: Call Me by Your Name
rows.overview: In the summer of 1983, a 17-year-old Elio spends his days in his family's villa in Italy. One day Oliver, a graduate student, arrives to assist Elio's father, a professor of Greco-Roman culture. Soon, Elio and Oliver discover a summer that will alter their lives forever.

rows.title: Before Sunrise

rows.title: Boyhood
rows.overview: The film tells a story of a divorced couple trying to raise their young son. The story follows the boy for twelve years, from first grade at age 6 through 12th grade at age 17-18, and examines his relationship with his parents as he grows.

rows.title: Her

To Theodore's surprise, a romantic relationship develops between him and his operating system. This unconventional love story blends science fiction and romance in a sweet tale that explores the nature of love and the ways that technology isolates and connects us all.

rows.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
rows.overview: Joel Barish, heartbroken that his girlfriend underwent a procedure to erase him from her memory, decides to do the same. However, as he watches his memories of her fade away, he realises that he still loves her, and may be too late to correct his mistake.

rows.title: Moonlight

rows.title: Aftersun

rows.title: Barton Fink
rows.overview: A renowned New York playwright is enticed to California to write for the movies and discovers the hellish truth of Hollywood.

rows.title: The Intouchables
rows.overview: A true story of two men who should never have met – a quadriplegic aristocrat who was injured in a paragliding accident and a young man from the projects.

rows.title: Secretary
rows.overview: A young woman, recently released from a mental hospital, gets a job as a secretary to a demanding lawyer, where their employer-employee relationship turns into a sexual, sadomasochistic one.

rows.title: The Girl Next Door

rows.title: Groundhog Day

rows.title: Regretting You

rows.title: Black Cat, White Cat

rows.title: Licorice Pizza

rows.title: Rental Family
rows.overview: An American actor in Tokyo struggles to find purpose until he lands an unusual gig: working for a Japanese 'rental family' agency, playing stand-in roles for strangers. rows.title: Sing Street
rows.overview: A boy growing up in Dublin during the 1980s escapes his strained family life by starting a band to impress the mysterious girl he likes.

rows.title: Castaway on the Moon

rows.title: WALL·E

Meanwhile, WALL•E chases EVE across the galaxy and sets into motion one of the most imaginative adventures ever brought to the big screen.

rows.title: Always

rows.title: Midnight Sun
rows.overview: Katie, a 17-year-old, has been sheltered since childhood and confined to her house during the day by a rare disease that makes even the smallest amount of sunlight deadly. Fate intervenes when she meets Charlie and they embark on a summer romance.

rows.title: Redeeming Love
rows.overview: A young couple's relationship clashes with the harsh realities of the California Gold Rush of 1850. rows.title: Bridesmaids
rows.overview: Annie's life is a mess. But when she finds out her lifetime best friend is engaged, she simply must serve as Lillian's maid of honor. rows.title: He's Just Not That Into You

Janine's not sure if she can trust her husband, Ben, who can't quite trust himself around Anna. Anna can't decide between the sexy married guy or her straightforward, no-sparks standby, Conor, who can't get over the fact that he can't have her. And Mary, who's found an entire network of loving, supportive men, just needs to find one who's straight.

rows.title: Dumb and Dumber
rows.overview: Lloyd and Harry are two men whose stupidity is really indescribable. When Mary, a beautiful woman, loses an important suitcase with money before she leaves for Aspen, the two friends (who have found the suitcase) decide to return it to her. After some "adventures" they finally get to Aspen where, using the lost money they live it up and fight for Mary's heart.

rows.title: White Chicks

rows.title: I Still Believe

rows.title: A Star Is Born

rows.title: The Shawshank Redemption

The Dark Knight resurfaces to protect a city that has branded him an enemy.
